The Look

It was never about the tree. It was the way of seeing.

הִנֵּה hinneh · לֹא תַחְמֹד lo tachmod

The Tanakh’s grammar of the gaze — how seeing turns the given into the taken, and how the text guards against it. Traced through repetition, inversion, and Leitwörter across all 39 books — the Behold / Covet framework.
